latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Edit — instant AI-powered video editing in the cloud.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM, up to 500MB); edit and export 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- No manual editing or software installation needed; just describe the edits you want.
- 100 free credits (7-day expiry) provided automatically on anonymous sign-up.
- Supports trimming, adding transitions, overlays, audio, and export; handles edits via keyword/intent.
- Fast processing (1–2 minutes per typical clip); transparent session and job management.
- Easy session setup and error handling; helpful instructions and workflow tips included.
